children: Trivedi brings more than 20 years of HR experience across banking, housing finance, asset management and financial services

Fusion Finance has appointed Chinmayi Trivedi as its Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) and Senior Managerial Personnel, effective 15 September 2026. She takes over the role following Pooja Mehta’s resignation as CHRO and Senior Managerial Personnel.

Trivedi brings more than 20 years of experience in human resources, with a career spanning banking, housing finance, asset management and financial services. Her experience covers recruitment, employee engagement, employee experience, performance management, employee relations, talent management and organisational development.

Before joining Fusion Finance, Trivedi was associated with Truhome Finance as Senior Vice President. Her role involved building and scaling the people function, with responsibilities across talent acquisition, performance management, employee engagement, digital HR transformation and organisational effectiveness.

Prior to Truhome Finance, Trivedi served as Head HR – Wholesale Finance Group at Piramal Capital & Housing Finance. Her responsibilities included HR strategy, talent management, compensation and benefits, employee experience, digital transformation and governance initiatives.

She has also held HR leadership roles at IDFC, where she worked with the asset management businesses across talent, performance, compensation and organisational development. She began her career with HDFC Bank as Manager – Human Resources.

Trivedi’s experience also includes leading HR transformation and change initiatives focused on people productivity and organisational effectiveness. Her career has involved working with business and senior leadership teams on people strategy, employee engagement and performance-related initiatives.
At Fusion Finance, her appointment comes as the company transitions its HR leadership. The board approved the appointment following the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
The board accepted Mehta’s resignation from the CHRO and Senior Managerial Personnel positions effective 15 September 2026. Her last working day with the company is 11 October 2026.

Trivedi’s appointment places an experienced HR professional from the financial services sector in charge of the company’s human resources function, with experience spanning talent, employee experience, performance management and HR transformation.
